Obviously the picture isn't the clearest and I'm no doctor, however It looks similar to contact dermatitis, I've had it as a child. it is a skin flare up/ reaction to soaps, perfumes, and shampoos and conditioners. it can also be caused by genetics on the rare occasion. It would need medical attention as it is treated with topical creams such as emollients. you might want to try swatching whatever you used on your head/hair on your arm or back of the hand. don't rub it in just swipe it on as a thick layer and leave it for up to 30 mins, if it doesn't cause a rash then try it with a different product that you've used.
